newsitem.title: USA: Danninger sees q4 eps $0.16 vs $0.05.
newsitem.headline: Danninger sees q4 eps $0.16 vs $0.05.

text.p: Danninger Medical Technology Inc said Monday preliminary results show fourth quarter profits rose to $600,000, or $0.16 per share, from $250,000, or $0.05 per share, in 1995 on an increase of 68 percent in revenues to about $6.1 million.
This would mark the first time total revenues would exceed $6 million in a quarter, the company said.
The anticipated increase in revenues is primarily attributable to a 137 percent increase in sales of the company's spinal implant products, it said, adding final results are expected by February 28.
